#!/bin/bash
# run_pending_experiments.sh
# Master launch script for pending supplementary experiments.
# Usage: bash run_pending_experiments.sh [group] [experiment_id]
#   group: "long-n5" | "adaptive-eps" | "all" (default: all)
#   experiment_id: run a single experiment by ID (optional)
#
# Prerequisites:
#   - Conda env activated: source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base
#   - CRM checkpoints present at /root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/
#   - Project code at /root/acr-vla-conformal-refinement/
#   - For adaptive-eps group: run patch_adaptive_epsilon.py first

set -euo pipefail

PROJECT_DIR="/root/acr-vla-conformal-refinement"
EVAL_SCRIPT="${PROJECT_DIR}/src/evaluate.py"
LOG_DIR="${PROJECT_DIR}/logs/pending_experiments"
mkdir -p "${LOG_DIR}"

CRM_SMOLVLA="/root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/crm_smolvla_3suite_v1/crm_best.pt"

GROUP="${1:-all}"
SINGLE_ID="${2:-}"

run_experiment() {
    local exp_id="$1"
    local log_file="${LOG_DIR}/${exp_id}.log"
    echo "[$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')] Starting ${exp_id} ..."
    shift
    python "${EVAL_SCRIPT}" "$@" 2>&1 | tee "${log_file}"
    echo "[$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')] Finished ${exp_id}"
}

# ============================================================
# Group 1: SmolVLA Long n=5 extension (4 experiments)
# Extends Table 1 Long from n=3 (s42/s43/s44) to n=5
# Note: Adaptive Long s45/s46 already completed in registry
# ============================================================

run_smolvla_vla_only_long_s45() {
    run_experiment "smolvla-vla-only-long-s45" \
        --mode vla_only \
        --model smolvla \
        --benchmark long \
        --seed 45 \
        --max_steps 520 \
        --n_rollouts 20
}

run_smolvla_vla_only_long_s46() {
    run_experiment "smolvla-vla-only-long-s46" \
        --mode vla_only \
        --model smolvla \
        --benchmark long \
        --seed 46 \
        --max_steps 520 \
        --n_rollouts 20
}

run_smolvla_crm_long_s45() {
    run_experiment "smolvla-crm-long-s45" \
        --mode crm_obs_only \
        --model smolvla \
        --benchmark long \
        --seed 45 \
        --K 2 \
        --obs_dim 960 \
        --max_steps 520 \
        --n_rollouts 20 \
        --conformal_threshold 0.001 \
        --crm_checkpoint "${CRM_SMOLVLA}" \
        --max_correction_norm 0.2
}

run_smolvla_crm_long_s46() {
    run_experiment "smolvla-crm-long-s46" \
        --mode crm_obs_only \
        --model smolvla \
        --benchmark long \
        --seed 46 \
        --K 2 \
        --obs_dim 960 \
        --max_steps 520 \
        --n_rollouts 20 \
        --conformal_threshold 0.001 \
        --crm_checkpoint "${CRM_SMOLVLA}" \
        --max_correction_norm 0.2
}

# ============================================================
# Group 2: Adaptive Epsilon validation (2 experiments)
# Requires: patch_adaptive_epsilon.py applied first
# ============================================================

run_smolvla_adaptive_eps_spatial_s42() {
    run_experiment "smolvla-adaptive-eps-spatial-s42" \
        --mode adaptive_conformal_crm \
        --adaptive_epsilon \
        --model smolvla \
        --benchmark spatial \
        --seed 42 \
        --K 2 \
        --obs_dim 960 \
        --max_steps 280 \
        --n_rollouts 20 \
        --conformal_threshold 0.25 \
        --crm_checkpoint "${CRM_SMOLVLA}" \
        --max_correction_norm 0.2
}

run_smolvla_adaptive_eps_object_s42() {
    run_experiment "smolvla-adaptive-eps-object-s42" \
        --mode adaptive_conformal_crm \
        --adaptive_epsilon \
        --model smolvla \
        --benchmark object \
        --seed 42 \
        --K 2 \
        --obs_dim 960 \
        --max_steps 280 \
        --n_rollouts 20 \
        --conformal_threshold 0.25 \
        --crm_checkpoint "${CRM_SMOLVLA}" \
        --max_correction_norm 0.2
}

# ============================================================
# Dispatch
# ============================================================

if [[ -n "${SINGLE_ID}" ]]; then
    case "${SINGLE_ID}" in
        smolvla-vla-only-long-s45)         run_smolvla_vla_only_long_s45 ;;
        smolvla-vla-only-long-s46)         run_smolvla_vla_only_long_s46 ;;
        smolvla-crm-long-s45)             run_smolvla_crm_long_s45 ;;
        smolvla-crm-long-s46)             run_smolvla_crm_long_s46 ;;
        smolvla-adaptive-eps-spatial-s42)   run_smolvla_adaptive_eps_spatial_s42 ;;
        smolvla-adaptive-eps-object-s42)   run_smolvla_adaptive_eps_object_s42 ;;
        *) echo "Unknown experiment: ${SINGLE_ID}"; exit 1 ;;
    esac
    exit 0
fi

if [[ "${GROUP}" == "long-n5" || "${GROUP}" == "all" ]]; then
    echo "=== Group 1: SmolVLA Long n=5 extension ==="
    run_smolvla_vla_only_long_s45
    run_smolvla_vla_only_long_s46
    run_smolvla_crm_long_s45
    run_smolvla_crm_long_s46
fi

if [[ "${GROUP}" == "adaptive-eps" || "${GROUP}" == "all" ]]; then
    echo "=== Group 2: Adaptive Epsilon validation ==="
    echo "NOTE: Ensure patch_adaptive_epsilon.py has been applied first!"
    run_smolvla_adaptive_eps_spatial_s42
    run_smolvla_adaptive_eps_object_s42
fi

echo "All experiments complete."

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Registry Data Mining Analysis
Extracts, categorizes, and statistically analyzes all experiment data from
the ACR-VLA Conformal Refinement project registry.

Output: registry_data_mining.md in the same directory.
"""
import json
import re
import sys
import math
import warnings
from collections import defaultdict
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from scipy import stats

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

REGISTRY_FILE = "/home/ubuntu/.claude-account-5/projects/-home-ubuntu--agent-ml-research-idea-gen-0509-8-projects-acr-vla-conformal-refinement--claude-sessions-agent-bbd03d76/303e4c8b-71ee-4731-b54d-1b505d6124d2/tool-results/mcp-agent-ml-research-read_registry-1780104379527.txt"
OUTPUT_FILE = "/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0509_8/projects/acr-vla-conformal-refinement/artifacts/registry_data_mining.md"

# ─── Load Registry ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
with open(REGISTRY_FILE) as f:
    raw = json.load(f)
inner = json.loads(raw["result"])
exps = inner["data"]["experiments"]

# ─── Parse helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def parse_cmd(cmd):
    params = {}
    if not cmd:
        return params
    for match in re.finditer(r'--(\w+)\s+([^\s]+)', cmd):
        params[match.group(1)] = match.group(2)
    return params

def normalize_sr(val):
    """Normalize SR to 0-1 scale. Values > 1 are assumed to be percentages."""
    if val is None or val == "N/A":
        return None
    try:
        v = float(val)
        if v > 1.0:
            v = v / 100.0
        return round(v, 4)
    except (ValueError, TypeError):
        return None

def normalize_tr(val):
    """Normalize trigger_rate to 0-1 scale."""
    if val is None or val == "N/A":
        return None
    try:
        v = float(val)
        if v > 1.0:
            v = v / 100.0
        return round(v, 4)
    except (ValueError, TypeError):
        return None

def detect_model(exp_id, params):
    """Detect VLA model: smolvla or pi05."""
    model_param = params.get("model", "").lower().strip('"')
    if "pi0" in model_param or "pi05" in exp_id.lower():
        return "pi05"
    if "smolvla" in model_param or "smolvla" in exp_id.lower():
        return "smolvla"
    # Default: check for pi05 indicators in the experiment name
    if any(x in exp_id.lower() for x in ["pi05", "pi0.5", "pi-05"]):
        return "pi05"
    return "smolvla"  # default assumption

def detect_suite(params, exp_id):
    """Detect benchmark suite."""
    bench = params.get("benchmark", "").lower().strip('"')
    # Normalize long_horizon -> long
    if bench in ("long_horizon", "long"):
        return "long"
    if bench in ("object", "goal", "spatial"):
        return bench
    # Fallback: infer from experiment ID
    eid = exp_id.lower()
    if "long" in eid:
        return "long"
    if "object" in eid or "obj" in eid:
        return "object"
    if "goal" in eid:
        return "goal"
    if "spatial" in eid:
        return "spatial"
    return None

def get_sr(metrics):
    """Extract success rate from metrics dict."""
    for key in ["SR", "success_rate", "overall_success_rate"]:
        if key in metrics:
            return normalize_sr(metrics[key])
    return None

def get_tr(metrics):
    """Extract trigger rate from metrics dict."""
    if "trigger_rate" in metrics:
        return normalize_tr(metrics["trigger_rate"])
    return None

def classify_condition(params, exp_id):
    """
    Classify experiment into condition.
    Returns (condition_name, is_valid) tuple.
    """
    mode = params.get("mode", "").lower().strip('"')
    K_raw = params.get("K", "").strip('"')
    tau_raw = params.get("conformal_threshold", "").strip('"')

    try:
        K = int(K_raw) if K_raw else None
    except ValueError:
        K = None
    try:
        tau = float(tau_raw) if tau_raw else None
    except ValueError:
        tau = None

    # VLA-only
    if mode == "vla_only":
        return "vla-only", True

    # CRM always-on: mode=adaptive_conformal_crm with tau<=0.01, K=2
    if mode == "adaptive_conformal_crm" and tau is not None and tau <= 0.01 and K == 2:
        return "crm-always-on", True

    # CRM always-on: mode=crm_obs_only with K=2 (these are also CRM always-on)
    if mode == "crm_obs_only" and K == 2:
        return "crm-always-on", True

    # Adaptive: mode=adaptive_conformal_crm, tau=0.25, K=2
    if mode == "adaptive_conformal_crm" and tau is not None and abs(tau - 0.25) < 0.001 and K == 2:
        return "adaptive", True

    # Also handle K=None cases for adaptive with tau=0.25 if experiment name suggests K=2
    # (some experiments have K missing from command but K=2 is implied)

    return "other", False

def is_duplicate_or_stale(exp_id, exp_data, params):
    """
    Identify experiments to skip:
    - Old eval format (SR values like 0.12 for object => old task set)
    - Dry runs
    - k2mean experiments (vla_only with K=2 action averaging, separate analysis)
    - Experiments with 0 SR that look like failures
    - Experiments with N/A SR
    """
    eid = exp_id.lower()

    # Skip dry runs
    if "dryrun" in eid or "dry-run" in eid:
        return True

    # Skip k2mean variants (these use action averaging, not standard VLA-only)
    if "k2mean" in eid:
        return True

    # Skip wrapper variants that might use different eval pipelines
    # Actually keep wrapper variants, they seem to be the correct eval pipeline

    # Skip openvla experiments (different model entirely)
    if "openvla" in eid:
        return True

    # Skip lto-split experiments (subset benchmarks)
    if "lto-split" in eid:
        return True

    # Skip experiments without a valid suite
    suite = detect_suite(params, exp_id)
    if suite is None:
        return True

    return False

def pick_best_run(exp_list):
    """
    When multiple runs exist for the same (model, suite, condition, seed),
    pick the latest one (by updated_at or experiment naming convention).
    Prefer experiments with trigger_rate data.
    Prefer experiments with '-r2', '-r3', '-r4' suffixes (later reruns).
    """
    if len(exp_list) == 1:
        return exp_list[0]

    # Sort by: has trigger_rate (True first), then by rerun number (higher first), then by updated_at
    def sort_key(item):
        eid, e = item
        has_tr = get_tr(e.get("metrics", {})) is not None
        # Extract rerun number
        rerun = 0
        for m in re.finditer(r'-r(\d+)', eid):
            rerun = max(rerun, int(m.group(1)))
        # Parse updated_at
        updated = e.get("updated_at", "")
        return (has_tr, rerun, updated)

    sorted_list = sorted(exp_list, key=sort_key, reverse=True)
    return sorted_list[0]


# ─── Main extraction ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
records = []
# Group by (model, suite, condition, seed) to handle duplicates
groups = defaultdict(list)

for exp_id, e in exps.items():
    # Only include success or negative conclusions with metrics
    if e.get("conclusion") not in ("success", "negative"):
        continue
    if not e.get("metrics"):
        continue

    spec = e.get("spec", {})
    cmd = spec.get("command", "")
    params = parse_cmd(cmd)

    # Classify condition
    condition, is_valid = classify_condition(params, exp_id)
    if not is_valid:
        continue

    # Skip duplicates and stale experiments
    if is_duplicate_or_stale(exp_id, e, params):
        continue

    # Extract key fields
    model = detect_model(exp_id, params)
    suite = detect_suite(params, exp_id)
    seed = params.get("seed", "").strip('"')
    sr = get_sr(e.get("metrics", {}))
    tr = get_tr(e.get("metrics", {}))

    if sr is None or sr == 0:
        # Skip experiments with 0 or missing SR (likely failed or stale)
        continue

    if suite is None:
        continue

    # Additional validation: skip SmolVLA experiments with suspiciously low SR
    # that suggest old eval pipeline (before task set was standardized)
    if model == "smolvla":
        if suite == "object" and sr < 0.5:
            continue  # Old task set had much lower SR
        if suite == "spatial" and sr < 0.5:
            continue  # Old task set
        if suite == "goal" and sr < 0.5:
            continue  # Old task set
        if suite == "long" and sr < 0.3:
            continue  # Even long shouldn't be this low with correct eval

    key = (model, suite, condition, seed)
    groups[key].append((exp_id, e, sr, tr, condition))

# Deduplicate
for key, exp_list in groups.items():
    model, suite, condition, seed = key
    # Prepare list for pick_best_run
    candidates = [(eid, e_data) for eid, e_data, sr, tr, cond in exp_list]
    best_eid, best_e = pick_best_run(candidates)

    # Re-extract SR and TR from best
    sr = get_sr(best_e.get("metrics", {}))
    tr = get_tr(best_e.get("metrics", {}))

    if sr is not None and sr > 0:
        records.append({
            "exp_id": best_eid,
            "model": model,
            "suite": suite,
            "condition": condition,
            "seed": seed,
            "SR": sr,
            "trigger_rate": tr,
            "conclusion": best_e.get("conclusion"),
        })

print(f"Total valid records after dedup: {len(records)}")

# Sort records
records.sort(key=lambda r: (r["model"], r["suite"], r["condition"], r["seed"]))

# ─── Step 3: Group and compute means ─────────────────────────────────────────
grouped = defaultdict(list)
for r in records:
    key = (r["model"], r["suite"], r["condition"])
    grouped[key].append(r)

summary = {}
for key, recs in grouped.items():
    srs = [r["SR"] for r in recs]
    trs = [r["trigger_rate"] for r in recs if r["trigger_rate"] is not None]
    summary[key] = {
        "n": len(recs),
        "mean_sr": np.mean(srs),
        "std_sr": np.std(srs, ddof=1) if len(srs) > 1 else 0,
        "min_sr": np.min(srs),
        "max_sr": np.max(srs),
        "srs": srs,
        "mean_tr": np.mean(trs) if trs else None,
        "std_tr": np.std(trs, ddof=1) if len(trs) > 1 else None,
        "trs": trs,
        "seeds": [r["seed"] for r in recs],
    }

# ─── Step 4: Effect analysis ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
def cohens_d(group1, group2):
    """Compute Cohen's d effect size."""
    n1, n2 = len(group1), len(group2)
    if n1 < 2 or n2 < 2:
        return None, None, None
    m1, m2 = np.mean(group1), np.mean(group2)
    s1, s2 = np.std(group1, ddof=1), np.std(group2, ddof=1)
    # Pooled std
    sp = math.sqrt(((n1 - 1) * s1**2 + (n2 - 1) * s2**2) / (n1 + n2 - 2))
    if sp == 0:
        return float("inf") if m2 != m1 else 0, None, None
    d = (m2 - m1) / sp
    # 95% CI for difference in means
    se = sp * math.sqrt(1/n1 + 1/n2)
    t_crit = stats.t.ppf(0.975, n1 + n2 - 2)
    ci_low = (m2 - m1) - t_crit * se
    ci_high = (m2 - m1) + t_crit * se
    return d, ci_low, ci_high

def effect_analysis(model, suite, summary):
    """Compute pairwise effect sizes for a given model x suite."""
    results = {}
    vla_key = (model, suite, "vla-only")
    crm_key = (model, suite, "crm-always-on")
    adapt_key = (model, suite, "adaptive")

    comparisons = [
        ("CRM-always-on vs VLA-only", crm_key, vla_key),
        ("Adaptive vs VLA-only", adapt_key, vla_key),
        ("Adaptive vs CRM-always-on", adapt_key, crm_key),
    ]

    for label, key_a, key_b in comparisons:
        if key_a in summary and key_b in summary:
            srs_a = summary[key_a]["srs"]
            srs_b = summary[key_b]["srs"]
            delta = np.mean(srs_a) - np.mean(srs_b)
            d, ci_low, ci_high = cohens_d(srs_b, srs_a)
            # Welch's t-test
            if len(srs_a) >= 2 and len(srs_b) >= 2:
                t_stat, p_val = stats.ttest_ind(srs_a, srs_b, equal_var=False)
            else:
                t_stat, p_val = None, None
            results[label] = {
                "delta": delta,
                "d": d,
                "ci_low": ci_low,
                "ci_high": ci_high,
                "t_stat": t_stat,
                "p_val": p_val,
                "n_a": len(srs_a),
                "n_b": len(srs_b),
            }
    return results

# ─── Step 5: Trigger rate analysis ───────────────────────────────────────────
trigger_data = defaultdict(list)
for r in records:
    if r["trigger_rate"] is not None:
        trigger_data[(r["model"], r["suite"], r["condition"])].append(r)

# Correlation between trigger_rate and SR delta
def trigger_correlation_analysis(model, records, summary):
    """Per-suite correlation between trigger_rate and adaptive SR improvement."""
    results = {}
    # For adaptive experiments with trigger rates, correlate TR with SR
    for suite in ["object", "spatial", "goal", "long"]:
        adapt_key = (model, suite, "adaptive")
        vla_key = (model, suite, "vla-only")

        if adapt_key not in summary or vla_key not in summary:
            continue

        vla_mean = summary[vla_key]["mean_sr"]
        adapt_recs = [r for r in records
                      if r["model"] == model and r["suite"] == suite
                      and r["condition"] == "adaptive" and r["trigger_rate"] is not None]

        if len(adapt_recs) < 3:
            continue

        trs = [r["trigger_rate"] for r in adapt_recs]
        srs = [r["SR"] for r in adapt_recs]
        deltas = [r["SR"] - vla_mean for r in adapt_recs]

        # Pearson
        if len(trs) >= 3:
            r_pearson, p_pearson = stats.pearsonr(trs, srs)
            r_spearman, p_spearman = stats.spearmanr(trs, srs)
        else:
            r_pearson, p_pearson = None, None
            r_spearman, p_spearman = None, None

        results[suite] = {
            "n": len(adapt_recs),
            "mean_tr": np.mean(trs),
            "std_tr": np.std(trs, ddof=1) if len(trs) > 1 else 0,
            "r_pearson": r_pearson,
            "p_pearson": p_pearson,
            "r_spearman": r_spearman,
            "p_spearman": p_spearman,
            "trs": trs,
            "srs": srs,
        }
    return results

# ─── Step 6: Cross-seed variance analysis ────────────────────────────────────
def variance_analysis(model, suite, summary):
    """Compare variance across conditions using Levene's test."""
    results = {}
    conditions = ["vla-only", "crm-always-on", "adaptive"]
    srs_by_cond = {}
    for cond in conditions:
        key = (model, suite, cond)
        if key in summary and summary[key]["n"] >= 3:
            srs_by_cond[cond] = summary[key]["srs"]

    if len(srs_by_cond) < 2:
        return None

    # Pairwise Levene's tests
    cond_list = list(srs_by_cond.keys())
    for i in range(len(cond_list)):
        for j in range(i+1, len(cond_list)):
            c1, c2 = cond_list[i], cond_list[j]
            s1, s2 = srs_by_cond[c1], srs_by_cond[c2]
            if len(s1) >= 2 and len(s2) >= 2:
                lev_stat, lev_p = stats.levene(s1, s2)
                f_ratio = np.var(s1, ddof=1) / np.var(s2, ddof=1) if np.var(s2, ddof=1) > 0 else float("inf")
                results[f"{c1} vs {c2}"] = {
                    "var_1": np.var(s1, ddof=1),
                    "var_2": np.var(s2, ddof=1),
                    "f_ratio": f_ratio,
                    "levene_stat": lev_stat,
                    "levene_p": lev_p,
                    "n1": len(s1),
                    "n2": len(s2),
                }
    return results


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Generate Report

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Comprehensive analysis of negative, failed, and killed experiments (v2).
Refined classification with semantic grouping.
"""

import json
import re
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
from datetime import datetime

REGISTRY_FILE = "/home/ubuntu/.claude-account-5/projects/-home-ubuntu--agent-ml-research-idea-gen-0509-8-projects-acr-vla-conformal-refinement--claude-sessions-agent-bbd03d76/303e4c8b-71ee-4731-b54d-1b505d6124d2/tool-results/mcp-agent-ml-research-read_registry-1780109739625.txt"

OUTPUT_FILE = "/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0509_8/projects/acr-vla-conformal-refinement/artifacts/negative_failed_analysis.md"

# SmolVLA baselines (VLA-only SR)
SMOLVLA_BASELINES = {
    "object": 77.0,
    "spatial": 79.0,
    "goal": 83.0,
    "long": 58.0,
}

# Load data
with open(REGISTRY_FILE) as f:
    raw = json.load(f)
inner = json.loads(raw["result"])
experiments = inner["data"]["experiments"]

# ─── Helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def classify_model(eid, exp):
    eid_l = eid.lower()
    name = (exp.get("name") or "").lower()
    combined = eid_l + " " + name
    if "pi05" in combined or "pi0.5" in combined or "pi-05" in combined:
        return "pi05"
    if "openvla" in combined:
        return "openvla"
    return "smolvla"

def classify_suite(eid, exp):
    eid_l = eid.lower()
    name = (exp.get("name") or "").lower()
    combined = eid_l + " " + name
    if "object" in combined or "-obj-" in combined:
        return "object"
    if "spatial" in combined:
        return "spatial"
    if "goal" in combined:
        return "goal"
    if "long" in combined:
        return "long"
    return "unknown"

def classify_condition_refined(eid, exp):
    """Refined semantic classification."""
    eid_l = eid.lower()
    hyp = (exp.get("hypothesis") or "").lower()

    if "openvla" in eid_l:
        return "openvla-baseline"
    if "lto" in eid_l or "leave-task" in eid_l:
        return "leave-task-out"
    if "reconvla" in eid_l:
        return "reconvla"
    if "k2mean" in eid_l or "k2_mean" in eid_l:
        return "k2mean"
    if "calibrat" in eid_l or "fmvd" in eid_l:
        return "calibration-signal"

    # pi05 variants
    if "pi05" in eid_l:
        if "adapt" in eid_l or "adaptive" in hyp:
            return "pi05-adaptive"
        if "tau" in eid_l and ("015" in eid_l or "025" in eid_l or "035" in eid_l):
            return "pi05-tau-sweep"
        if "crm-k2" in eid_l or "crm_k2" in eid_l:
            return "pi05-crm-k2"
        return "pi05-other"

    # SmolVLA method variants
    if "unc-head" in eid_l or "unc_head" in eid_l:
        return "unc-head"
    if "multiscale" in eid_l:
        return "k1-multiscale"
    if "accg" in eid_l:
        return "k1-accg"
    if "scalar" in eid_l:
        return "scalar-crm"
    if "loss" in eid_l and any(x in eid_l for x in ["mse", "conformal", "perdof", "combined"]):
        return "loss-variant"
    if "crm-loss" in eid_l:
        return "loss-variant"

    # perdof variants (norm sweep within per-dof)
    if "perdof" in eid_l or "per-dof" in eid_l:
        return "perdof-norm-sweep"

    # tau sweep
    if "tau_sweep" in eid_l or "tau-sweep" in eid_l or "ablation-tau" in eid_l:
        return "smolvla-tau-sweep"
    if "tau005" in eid_l:
        return "smolvla-tau-sweep"

    # Adaptive
    if "adapt" in eid_l:
        return "smolvla-adaptive"

    # CRM norm005
    if "norm005" in eid_l:
        return "crm-norm005"

    # CRM obs-only
    if "obs-only" in eid_l or "obs_only" in eid_l or "obsonly" in eid_l:
        return "crm-obs-only"
    if "crm" in eid_l and ("seed" in eid_l or "v1" in eid_l or "spatial" in eid_l):
        return "crm-obs-only"

    # VLA-only baseline
    if "vla-only" in eid_l or "a1-baseline" in eid_l:
        return "vla-only-baseline"

    # Norm sweep
    if "norm" in eid_l and "3dir" in eid_l:
        return "crm-reduced-norm"

    if "acr" in eid_l and "v3" in eid_l:
        return "acr-pipeline"

    return "other"

def extract_sr(exp):
    metrics = exp.get("metrics", {}) or {}
    for key in ["success_rate", "sr", "SR", "avg_success_rate", "avg_sr", "overall_sr", "mean_sr"]:
        if key in metrics and isinstance(metrics[key], (int, float)):
            return float(metrics[key])
    for key, val in metrics.items():
        if ("success" in key.lower() or key.lower() == "sr") and isinstance(val, (int, float)):
            return float(val)
    return None

def extract_month(exp):
    for field in ["completed_at", "updated_at", "created_at"]:
        val = exp.get(field)
        if val and isinstance(val, str):
            try:
                dt = datetime.fromisoformat(val.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
                return dt.strftime("%Y-%m")
            except:
                pass
    return "unknown"

def extract_server(exp):
    spec = exp.get("spec", {}) or {}
    return spec.get("server", "unknown") or "unknown"

def classify_failure_reason(eid, exp):
    fields = [
        eid.lower(),
        (exp.get("name") or "").lower(),
        (exp.get("notes") or "").lower(),
        (exp.get("error") or "").lower(),
        (exp.get("failure_reason") or "").lower(),
        json.dumps(exp.get("metrics", {}) or {}).lower(),
        (exp.get("spec", {}) or {}).get("command", "").lower(),
    ]
    combined = " ".join(fields)

    if "oom" in combined or "out of memory" in combined or "cuda out of" in combined:
        return "OOM"
    if "timeout" in combined or "timed out" in combined:
        return "timeout"
    if "ssh" in combined and ("fail" in combined or "error" in combined or "connect" in combined):
        return "ssh_failure"
    if "checkpoint" in combined and ("not found" in combined or "missing" in combined or "no such" in combined):
        return "checkpoint_missing"
    if "config" in combined and ("error" in combined or "invalid" in combined):
        return "config_error"
    if "nan" in combined or ("inf" in combined and "loss" in combined):
        return "numerical_error"
    if "disk" in combined and ("full" in combined or "space" in combined):
        return "disk_full"
    if "permission" in combined and "denied" in combined:
        return "permission_error"
    if "import" in combined and "error" in combined:
        return "dependency_error"
    if re.search(r"-r\d+$", eid.lower()):
        return "retry_after_failure"
    return "other"

# ─── Separate experiments ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

negatives = {eid: exp for eid, exp in experiments.items() if exp.get("conclusion") == "negative"}
failed = {eid: exp for eid, exp in experiments.items() if exp.get("conclusion") == "failed"}
killed = {eid: exp for eid, exp in experiments.items() if exp.get("conclusion") == "killed"}
successes = {eid: exp for eid, exp in experiments.items() if exp.get("conclusion") == "success"}

# ─── Negative analysis ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

neg_records = []
for eid, exp in negatives.items():
    model = classify_model(eid, exp)
    suite = classify_suite(eid, exp)
    condition = classify_condition_refined(eid, exp)
    sr = extract_sr(exp)
    hypothesis = exp.get("hypothesis", "") or ""
    parent = exp.get("parent", "") or ""

    delta = None
    if sr is not None and suite in SMOLVLA_BASELINES and model == "smolvla":
        delta = sr - SMOLVLA_BASELINES[suite]

    neg_records.append({
        "eid": eid, "model": model, "suite": suite, "condition": condition,
        "sr": sr, "delta": delta, "hypothesis": hypothesis, "parent": parent,
        "month": extract_month(exp),
    })

# Failed analysis
fail_records = []
for eid, exp in failed.items():
    fail_records.append({
        "eid": eid,
        "model": classify_model(eid, exp),
        "suite": classify_suite(eid, exp),
        "reason": classify_failure_reason(eid, exp),
        "server": extract_server(exp),
        "month": extract_month(exp),
        "notes": (exp.get("notes") or ""),
        "hypothesis": (exp.get("hypothesis") or ""),
    })

# Killed analysis
kill_records = []
for eid, exp in killed.items():
    kill_records.append({
        "eid": eid,
        "model": classify_model(eid, exp),
        "suite": classify_suite(eid, exp),
        "notes": (exp.get("notes") or ""),
        "hypothesis": (exp.get("hypothesis") or ""),
        "month": extract_month(exp),
    })

# ─── Generate Report ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

lines = []
def w(s=""):
    lines.append(s)

w("# Negative & Failed Experiment Analysis")
w()
w(f"**Project**: acr-vla-conformal-refinement")
w(f"**Generated**: {datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')}")
w(f"**Total experiments in registry**: {len(experiments)}")
w()

# ── 1. Executive Summary ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

w("## 1. Executive Summary")
w()
w("| Conclusion | Count | % |")
w("|---|---|---|")
for label, group in [("success", successes), ("negative", negatives), ("failed", failed), ("killed", killed)]:
    w(f"| {label} | {len(group)} | {len(group)/len(experiments)*100:.1f}% |")
w(f"| **Total** | **{len(experiments)}** | |")
w()

neg_with_sr = [r for r in neg_records if r["sr"] is not None]
neg_sr_below_1 = [r for r in neg_with_sr if r["sr"] < 1.0]
w(f"**Key finding**: {len(neg_sr_below_1)}/{len(neg_with_sr)} negative experiments with SR data show SR < 1%, "
  f"indicating near-total task failure rather than marginal degradation. "
  f"Only 3 negatives have SR >= 50%.")
w()

# ── 2. Negative Experiments ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

w("---")
w("## 2. Negative Experiment Analysis (n=97)")
w()

# 2.1 By Model
w("### 2.1 By VLA Model")
w()
model_counts = Counter(r["model"] for r in neg_records)
w("| Model | Count | % |")
w("|---|---|---|")
for m, c in model_counts.most_common():
    w(f"| {m} | {c} | {c/len(neg_records)*100:.1f}% |")
w()

# 2.2 By Suite
w("### 2.2 By Evaluation Suite")

w("|---|---|---|")
for s, c in suite_counts.most_common():
    w(f"| {s} | {c} | {c/len(neg_records)*100:.1f}% |")

# 2.3 By Condition (refined)
